model_annotation: This chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty medical terms across six medical specialties, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) against versions fine-tuned on each of the six specialties. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categorical groups: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals (-27, -26, -25, -24, -23, -22). Each group contains seven bars representing the base model and six fine-tuned variants. The bars extend downward from less negative values (closer to -22) toward more negative values, where values closer to -22 indicate higher probability. The legend identifies the bar colors as follows: Mistralv0.2-Base in light blue, and fine-tuned models in varying shades of tan and brown — Cardio (light yellow-tan), Gastro (light peach), Infect (medium peach-orange), Neuro (darker peach-orange), Obstetrics (medium brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across all six specialty term groups, the Mistralv0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently reaches approximately -22, making it the tallest (least negative) bar in every group. The fine-tuned model bars vary in height across groups; for example, in the Cardio group, several fine-tuned bars extend down to approximately -26 or -26.5, while in the Neuro group, the fine-tuned bars range from roughly -22.5 to -25. In the Gastro group, the fine-tuned bars span from about -22.5 to -24.5. The Obstetrics and Pediatrics groups show fine-tuned bars generally clustering between approximately -23 and -24.5. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized through bolding, outlining, or annotation beyond the color coding described in the legend.
